Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
Tournament report

The plan was to experience a VTES weekend (casuals and tournament) again after a long time. Friday afternoon, after the improbability data had gradually turned into possibilities, Ali and I got into the car ... and due to a full closure on the A3, we were allowed to get to know the villages and country lanes in the area of Neustadt (Wied). Unfortunately, this tested the patience of the 4 players already waiting in the pub (45 minutes late), but we were still able to play two 6-player tables.
In the first game (the weekly league game one of the Bochum playgroup), I tested the deck I had put together especially for the tournament and found my suspicions confirmed: Certain concepts cannot be adopted equally powerful with every crypt or with all combinations of disciplines. Based on Otso Saariluoma's decks "Feral High Council" and "Usurper High Council", I actually wanted to give a variant with big-cap vampires with DOM and OBF of groups 1 and 2 a try, but Obfuscate simply does not have a comparable usefulness as Protean or Blood Sorcery.
Therefore, I rebuilt the deck at night in the hotel and then took a variant of the "Feral High Council", which is basically Stanislava Vote & Bloat, to the tournament. I didn't know how the metagame would turn out, but I feared the presence of a few rush decks, so among some other minor changes I added 2x Obedience to be on the safe side.
The event “SpieleWahnsinn" (Gaming Madness) offered a very pleasant ambience and plenty of space for the tournament to settle comfortably. 15 participants turned up, a large turnout for a 2R+F tournament. Everyone received a booster of the old VTES edition, wow!

Round 1
Alf, Nana War Ghoul Apocalypse => Flo, Malk g6 Stealth Bleed => Erica, !Nos Combat => me, Stanislava Vote & Bloat => Hardy, Blood Brothers Kiev Power Bleed.

How good that the !Nos deck was kept busy by the Malks. Also good that my Bloat votes kept both Alf and Erica in the game. Also saw two cases of Archon Investigation ... Overall, though, I was too slow to oust Alf as well after having ousted Hardy, as the finally got the first War Ghoul in play and some setup. 1.5 VP for me.

Round 2
me, Stanislava Vote & Bloat => Didi, Malgorzata Vote & Bloat => Flo, Malk g6 Stealth Bleed => Markus, !Tor g23 Breed & Bleed => Ali, Weenie Malk g12 Anarchs Wall

Well, in this game, I could only hope to survive and maybe just make it to the finals with a total of 2 VP: More votes in front of me than I could get together because of Gerald Windham, a wall behind me that I knew was dangerous. If Ali hadn't gotten friendly fire from the Malk Leaders (a Govern & Conditioning bleed for 6), I certainly wouldn't have been able to equip the Heart of Nizchetus. Thanks to the Heart, it was bearable not to have a big card cycling due to the lack of actions. At some point, Ali had “cleaned up” behind himself and had both Smiling Jack and Constant Revolution in play, but then time was up. 0.5 VP for me.

Finals, yeah!
Equal on victory and tournament points with Flo, thanks to better dice roll I received the 4th rank. The Seating Dance according to the new rules (showing 3 random Crypt cards) proved to be very “telling”.

Michael H., Obfuscate Toreador g23 Bleed => Rodinei, Matasuntha Wall => Flo, Malk g6 Stealth Bleed => me, Stanislava Vote & Bloat => Markus, !Tor Breed & Bleed

I rated my chances of winning the finals as "existing" - if Flo's Malks wouldn't be too fast. My crypt showed Stanislava, 2x Ingrid Rossler as well as Hartmut Stover, and I would start the game with 4 transfers, because Michael pushed himself forward as the starting player.
It would turn out that Michael exerted a lot of pressure against his Prey, Rodinei virtually none, Flo, I and Markus each exerted moderate pressure "to the left". My bloat votes once again distributed pool in the right places, otherwise either Rodinei or Michael would certainly have left the table earlier. When I had all three vampires of the starting crypt in play and already felt quite satisfied, Markus played Fear of Mekhet on Stanislava ... oh, crap! In addition, Flo played Revelatios on superior level on me, thus I had to play with an open hand.
Interestingly, the open hand didn't turn out to be a real disadvantage, it even helped the game did not get delayed unnecessarily. I managed to have a new Stanislava enter the game. About half an hour before time-out I ousted Markus, Michael right after that Rodinei - and it looked like either Michael or time would run away from me. Flo played very fairly and did not delay the game unnecessarily and kept his moves as short as necessary. With 8 minutes to go, the signs finally were right: Dreams of the Sphinx and Heart of Nizchetus offered me an outstanding open hand. With Parity Shift I was able to cleverly redistribute pool from Michael to Flo, so that the subsequent Reins of Power led to the desired oust (only) of Michael. Stanislava's bleed for 3 then took Flo out of the game. 4 VP + GW.

Very exciting finals, sovereignly accompanied by Hardy and Steffen as judges. The tournament edge will get a place of honour in my tournament luggage. Thanks to all who made this VTES weekend such a nice experience!
